transcription_notes: Manuscript: Cambridge UL MS Add. 1570, a dense 3-column Ethiopic book hand with red rubrication for divisions and marginal notes (marginalia ignored per scope; only the 3-column body transcribed). Hi-res ~80MP scans; parchment is clean and the hand is highly legible throughout 1 Kings 1 with only one genuinely abraded spot. 1 Kings 1 begins on f126r, LEFT column, immediately after the chapter rubric. The page carries a running header 'ሣልስ ፡ ነገሥት' (Third Kings) in the top margin; below it the coarse chapter rubric 'ምዕራፍ' then red 'ክፍል ፡ ፩' (a fine liturgical ክፍል subdivision, treated as noise, not a modern chapter break), then verse 1 'ወዳዊትሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ልህቀ...'. No 2 Samuel 24 text leaks in (the previous book ended on the preceding folio f125v; f126r opens fresh with the Kings rubric + 1 Kings 1:1). 1 Kings 1 spans f126r (all three columns, ~35 lines each) and continues onto f126v LEFT column only. It ENDS on f126v, LEFT column, line ~27, at '...ወይቤሎ ፡ ስሎሞን ፡ ሑት ፡ ቤተከ' ('and Solomon said: Go to thy house', = v53). Immediately after comes a red liturgical marker 'ክፍል ፡ ፫ ።' (Section 3) which here coincides with the real chapter break, then 1 Kings 2 begins 'ወቀርበ ፡ መዋዕሊሁ ፡ ለዳዊት ፡ ለመዊት ፡ ወእዘዘ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ወልዱ' ('And the days of David drew near that he should die, and he charged Solomon his son') — exactly the defined ch.2 incipit; transcription STOPS there (f126v middle/right columns and f127r/f127v are all ch.2 and were NOT transcribed). Division marks seen: red 'ምዕራፍ' (coarse, at the head of ch.1 on f126r-L), and fine red 'ክፍል ፡ ፩' / 'ክፍል ፡ ፪' (within ch.1, f126r-R) / 'ክፍል ፡ ፫' (at the ch.1/ch.2 boundary, f126v-L); ክፍል numerals treated as noise per instructions and stripped from tokens; abundant red ✣ cross dividers between clauses, also stripped from tokens but kept in geez. RECENSIONAL PECULIARITIES (transcribed faithfully, NOT normalised to the printed text): (1) v1 word order 'ወዳዊትሰ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ልህቀ' (David before 'king') vs the usual 'and king David was old'. (2) 'እልባስ' (accusative) where printed has 'በአልባስ'. (3) Names in a distinct orthography: Abishag = 'አቢሳሁ', the Shunammite = 'አሜናዊተ', Haggith = 'አጊት', Zeruiah = 'ኢሩሕየ', Jehoiada = 'ዮዳሄ'/'ዮዳዜ', Zoheleth = 'ዝሕልት', En-rogel = 'ዓይነ ፡ እግር', Cherethites/Pelethites = 'ኪሊቲ ፡ ወፈልቲ' / 'ኬሊቲ ፡ ወፈሊቲ'. (4) The standard 'fifty men' is written with a rubricated Ethiopic numeral '፶' + 'ብእሲ'. (5) [CORRECTED on re-collation] No vv.15-16 minus: re-reading the BOTTOM ~3 lines of f126r col1 + the wrap into col2 L1 recovered the full text that an earlier pass had wrongly dropped at the col1->col2 turn. f126r col1 ends '...ትትናገሪ ፡ አንቲ ፡ ምስለ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ሀየ ፡ ወአነ ፡ እበውእ ፡ ድኃሬኪ ፡ ወእፌጽም ፡ ነገረኪ ፡ ወቦአት ፡ ቤርሳቤሕ ፡ ኀበ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ውስተ ፡ ጽርሕ ፡ ወንጉሥሰ ፡ ልህቀ ፡ ጥቀ ✣ ወአቢሳ ፡ ስሜናዊት ፡ ትትለእኮ ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወደናንት ፡ ቤርሳቤሕ ፡ ወስገደት ፡ ለንጉሥ ፡ ወይቤላ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ምንተ ፡ ከን-' then col2 L1 '-ኪ ። ወትቤሎ ...'.  So new v14 carries the v14-tail and new v15 is the restored 'Bathsheba enters the chamber / the king very old / Abishag the Shunammite ministering / she did obeisance / What wouldest thou' sense-unit; new v16 = the speech 'ወትቤሎ ፡ እግዚእየ ፡ ንጉሥ ...' (formerly mislabelled). (6) [CORRECTED on re-collation] No vv.42b-43 minus: f126r col3 does NOT stop at 'ወሬሁ'.  Its last ~5 lines read 'ናታን ፡ ወልዱ ፡ አብያታር ፡ ካህን ፡ ቦአ ፡ ወይቤ ፡ አዶንያስ ፡ ባእ ፡ እስመ ፡ ብእሴ ፡ ኃየል ፡ አንተ ፡ ወሥናየ ፡ ትዜኑ ✣ ወአውሥእ ፡ ናታን ፡ ወይቤ ፡ ለአዶንያስ ፡ እግዚእነ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ዳዊት ፡ አንገሠ ፡ ለሰሎሞን ፡ ወፈነወ ፡ ንጉሥ ፡ ምስሌሁ ፡ ለሳ-' and f126v-L resumes mid-word '-ደቅሁ ፡ ካህን ፡ ወናታሁ ፡ ነቢይ ...' (the word ለሳደቅሁ is split across the f126r-col3 / f126v-L turn).  Restored as new v42 (Jonathan/Jonathan-as-ናታን enters; Adonijah: come in, good tidings) and new v43 (Jonathan's report: David made Solomon king; sent with him ለሳደቅሁ ካህን / Benaiah / Cherethites-Pelethites; rode the mule; Zadok & Nathan anointed him in Gihon — this absorbs the formerly-separate v41 body verbatim).  After restoring both dropped boundary blocks the chapter re-segments CONTIGUOUSLY 1..52 by the sense-units CAM actually presents (numbering is not the printed-Bible numbering). UNCERTAIN/DAMAGED: exactly one genuinely illegible span — on f126r RIGHT column, line 1 (the verse containing 'my lord king ... David for ever', Bathsheba's blessing): a 2-3 word stretch of faded/abraded RED rubric between 'ንጉሥ' and 'ዳዊት' could not be read even with red-channel isolation and contrast enhancement; marked with the ⟦illegible⟧ sentinel + one illegible marker (NOT reconstructed from the expected text). Other minor doubts (read but transcribed literally, not flagged as illegible): the bridge word 'ወለእኪ' opening v53 on f126v-L (an apparently abbreviated/variant form before 'ንጉሥ ፡ ስሎሞን'); 'ወይቤሎ/ወይቤሉ ፡ ስሎሞን' at the very end of ch.1 (final letter ሎ vs ሉ ambiguous); a few enclitic 'ሰ/ኒ' attachments and the 'ይሬእዐ/ይሬእ ፡ ዐ' spelling in v48. Source quality overall: EXCELLENT for this chapter — no water/insect damage obscuring body text, marginalia do not intrude into the columns, ink crisp; the lone abraded red patch in f126r-R line1 is the only real legibility gap.
